How to use this PDF

  • Clickable contents. The master TOC on the next page — and every cross-reference in this book — is a live link. Click any row, chip, or card ID to jump straight to it.
  • Category color coding. Each of the 13 endorsement categories owns a color (legend below). Category banners, bundle headers, and endorsement cards all wear their category color.
  • Endorsement chips. Inline chips like A.6 jump to that endorsement's full card — verbatim AC text, plain-English notes, and citations.
  • External links. eCFR regulation citations and FAA source links open in your browser and are marked with ↗.
  • PDF bookmarks. Your PDF viewer's outline/bookmark panel mirrors this book's heading structure (parts → categories → bundles → endorsements) for quick navigation.
